moworks.notes: cubic-bezier(.25, .1, .25, 1) (CSS 'ease'), 350 ms. Rule: same as CSS ease; pick it on purpose, not as an unexamined default. GSAP has no 'ease' name: write custom(M0,0 C .25,.1 .25,1 1,1); proposed alias css.ease. Small demo: 1200 ms across 114 px beside the curve graph and a 12-frame spacing ruler (guides, not ported). Params: duration (0.35 s) · ease (custom .25,.1,.25,1).
